historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr cross-checked to FY2027 guidance (~5% local-currency sales growth); equity CAGR unusable
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR cannot be computed: shareholders' equity went from $282.7M (FY2020) to -$23.6M (FY2025) because buybacks ($4.65bn over FY2021-25) exceeded net income. The house default of selecting on book-value growth is not applicable; revenue and owner-FCF growth are used instead. EPS 5-yr CAGR (11.0%) runs at twice revenue growth (5.5%) because of margin expansion and a ~3%/yr share-count reduction - the latter is not credited in this model.
historical_growth.notes: Fiscal years FY2020/FY2022 to FY2025. FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC; no interest-income strip, net debtor): FY2020 613.5, FY2022 718.2, FY2025 826.1. Owner and reported FCF CAGRs are effectively identical (6.13% vs 6.07% 5-yr) - SBC is ~0.55% of revenue and not growing faster than cash flow. The 3-yr figures span the 2023-24 China/biopharma destocking trough and understate the run-rate; 9M-2026 revenue is +5.9% and Q3-2026 +6.3% year on year.

scenario_narratives.base: The 2026 recovery normalises rather than accelerates. Laboratory and China demand settle at the ~5% local-currency growth management has guided for 2027; service (about a quarter of sales, growing ~8%) keeps outgrowing product and lifts mix; pricing and the SternDrive/Spinnaker programmes offset the Section 301 tariffs, as management says they will. Adjusted EBITDA margin drifts up ~20bp a year from 31.4% to 33.4%, well short of the pace of the last decade. Free cash flow roughly equals unlevered net income, as it has historically. No credit is taken for the buyback shrinking the share count.
scenario_narratives.bull: China and Asia (16% of sales but ~29% of segment profit) stay in the double-digit recovery seen in Q3-2026 for several years, biopharma bioprocessing and reshoring-driven industrial capex come through, and the lab replacement cycle that management calls 'unclear in timing' arrives. Sales compound at 6-7% and the margin resumes something close to its 2015-2021 trajectory, reaching 36% as service mix, pricing analytics and the single-instance ERP pay off. Requires both the demand recovery and the margin programme to deliver.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2026 China rebound proves to be stimulus-driven and reverses, as it did in 2023-24, taking the highest-margin region with it; a further tariff round on Swiss and Chinese production (most products are single-sourced from those sites) cannot be fully priced through, and lower-cost emerging-market competitors take share in industrial and food retail. Sales stall in year 2 and recover to only ~3%; the margin gives back 150bp and stays near 30%. With net debt of ~$2.0bn against EBITDA of ~$1.3bn the covenant (3.5x) is not threatened - this is an earnings bear case, not a solvency one. A slower-growing franchise is capitalised at no more than 16x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Unlevered owner FCF built from components off a trailing-twelve-month base, discounted at 8.5%, terminal value the lower of Gordon growth and a 16-20x cap, three scenarios probability-weighted. SBC (0.55% of revenue) is expensed and the share count held flat, so house and street values sit close together and the accounting-regime band is narrow. The market prices MTD on buyback-assisted EPS growth (low-teens guided for 2027); this model values the enterprise cash flow and gives no credit for count shrinkage, which is the main reason it lands well below both the price and sell-side targets.
key_risks_to_valuation: Margin base is constructed, not reported: the company publishes no operating-income or EBITDA line, and the TTM figure is adjusted for a ~$24M net tariff-refund benefit. Each 1pp of terminal EBITDA margin is worth roughly 3-4% of value.
Discount rate: 8.5% is below a mechanical CAPM build (~9.4%). The required-return table shows value at 9-15%.
China concentration - ~16% of sales but ~29% of segment profit and of production.
Tariff regime (Section 301 at 12.5% on Swiss and Chinese imports from July 2026) and management's claim of full mitigation are untested over a full year.

Terminal value is the bulk of enterprise value; a 20x cap on a business the market currently pays ~35x earnings for is a deliberate brake, and is why the model will look low against the price for as long as that multiple persists.
Bolt-on acquisitions are neither charged nor credited; if they are a recurring ~$50-100M/yr use of cash needed to sustain 5% growth, FCF is overstated by ~5-10%.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular-session close); 52-week range 1023.05-1806.58
data_sources.financials: MTD_Metrics.csv / MTD.duckdb (SEC XBRL); income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and share count read directly from MTD_Annual_FY2025.txt (lines 3331-3350, 3467-3481) and MTD_Quarterly_Q3-2026.txt (lines 1712, 1753-1807, 1822-1843, 1928-1943, 2446-2452, 2632)
data_sources.qualitative: MTD_Analysis.json (2026-11-15): guidance as of Q3-2026 results reported 2026-11-06 - FY2026 adj. EPS $47.70-47.90, FY2027 adj. EPS $52.50-53.50 on ~5% local-currency sales growth, FY2026 capex ~$130M, buybacks $825-875M

inputs.share_count_basis: Period-end fully diluted: 19,890,405 shares outstanding at 2026-09-30 (Q3-2026 10-Q cover and balance sheet) plus 54,569 treasury-method common equivalents (Q3-2026 10-Q EPS note). Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows; the ~$780M/yr buyback is not credited as count shrinkage, since the cash that funds it is the FCF being discounted (crediting both would double-count).
inputs.sbc_source: Cash-flow statement add-back, TTM to 2026-09-30 (FY2025 22.512 - 9M-2025 16.027 + 9M-2026 16.786). No separate equity-award tax line is disclosed (awards are mainly options exercised for cash, not net-share settled), so the add-back is the full charge.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Risk-free ~4.3% (10y UST) + ~5% ERP x beta ~1.1 gives cost of equity ~9.8%; pre-tax debt ~3.4% (FY2025 interest 68.5 on ~2.1bn, 71% fixed) at ~5% of capital at market weights gives WACC ~9.4% mechanically. Set at 8.5% for a business with ~25% recurring service revenue, 59-60% gross margin, no customer >1% of sales and two decades of margin expansion. One WACC for all three scenarios: risk is charged in the scenario paths and weights, not twice.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: rent is already inside SG&A/cost of sales and therefore inside the EBITDA margin. Lease liabilities (~$129M at FY2025) are NOT added to net debt. One treatment only.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (dcf-methods routing row 'operating company'). Mettler-Toledo is a precision-instrument manufacturer with a large service annuity; value is a stream of unlevered free cash flow. Negative/near-zero book equity (-$23.6M FY2025, +$77.7M Q3-2026) is the residue of ~$10.6bn of cumulative buybacks, not distress, so the distressed-shell row does not apply and equity/book-value CAGRs are meaningless here. BASE PERIOD: FY0 is the trailing twelve months to 2026-09-30 (FY2025 - 9M-2025 + 9M-2026, all reported actuals), chosen so the flows start the day after the balance sheet used for net debt and shares; anchoring on FY2025 with FY2026 as year 1 would count nine months of cash already spent on buybacks. Year 1 is therefore the 12 months to Sep-2027. base_revenue 4,226.4 = TTM reported 4,198.4 plus the one-time $28M tariff customer-refund reduction of net sales. ONE-OFFS STRIPPED: the 2026 IEEPA tariff refund ($52M reduction of cost of sales, less $28M customer refunds = ~$24M net operating benefit, ~$49M net cash received to date) is excluded from the margin base; reported_fcf/last_fcf are as reported and so still contain it. MARGIN BASE: the company reports no operating-income or EBITDA line. Built here as gross profit - R&D - SG&A (TTM 1,276.7; 1,252.7 ex tariff net benefit = 29.6% of sales) + depreciation 52.8 + SBC 23.3 = adj. EBITDA 1,328.8 = 31.4% of normalised sales, before SBC. Restructuring (~$18-20M every year) is treated as recurring and sits inside the forward margin path rather than being added back. D&A path includes amortization (TTM 78.1) as well as depreciation. INTEREST INCOME: not stripped - the company is a net debtor (cash $52M vs debt $2.0bn) and interest income is not separately disclosed within 'Other charges (income), net'. BUYBACKS: funded repurchaser - TTM $782.5M of repurchases against ~$23M of SBC, so the flat count is far more than paid for. PENSION: defined-benefit plans were net overfunded by ~$178M at FY2025 (mostly non-US surplus that is not distributable); not added to the bridge. US plan buy-out expected 2027 with a ~$28M non-cash charge. PRICE: regular-session close, not an after-hours print. Sell-side targets cited in the Analysis file cluster at $1,300-1,575, below the price and above this model.

base.growth_rationale: Year 1 (12 months to Sep-2027) blends a Q4-2026 running ~+6% with FY2027 guidance of ~5% local-currency growth. 5% held through year 4 (management's long-run algorithm is mid-single-digit sales), fading to 3.5%.
base.margin_rationale: TTM underlying adj. EBITDA margin 31.4% (pre-SBC, ex tariff refund). FY2027 EPS guidance of $52.50-53.50 on ~5% sales and ~3% fewer shares implies ~50bp of operating margin expansion; the path takes ~20bp a year, about a third of the 2015-2021 pace, and never returns restructuring charges to the margin.
base.sbc_rationale: Held flat at the TTM 0.55% of revenue. It has sat at 0.5-0.6% for a decade; a decline is not assumed.
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 capex guidance ~$130M is ~3.1% of sales; TTM actual 2.7%. Bolt-on acquisitions (~$94M in 2025) are not modelled and neither is their revenue.
base.tax_rationale: Applied to EBIT (unlevered, so no interest shield). FY2025 provision 17.1%, cash taxes 17.2% of pre-tax; 9M-2026 provision 18.9%. Stepped to 20% for OECD Pillar Two drift.
base.wc_rationale: Negative: a manufacturer whose receivables and inventory exceed payables plus ~$247M of deferred service revenue; growth consumes cash.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20%, above the 15% default: China supplies ~29% of segment profit and production and has already swung from sharp decline to +13% within three years, and the tariff regime changed three times in 2026. Base 50%: it is management's own 2027 guidance extended with a modest margin drift. Bull 30%, below the 35% default: it needs a durable China/biopharma upcycle and a return to the prior decade's pace of margin expansion at the same time.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
